fact_types.title: You, the taxpayer, have a social security number or individual taxpayer identification number issued on or before the due date of your 2025 return, including extensions (Schedule 8812 instructions, i1040s8.txt:47-50; Form 1040 Step 5 question 1, i1040gi-2025.txt:1098-1100). Asked when an other dependent is counted. The spouse has its own question. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.

Asked on a joint return when any dependent counts. Contributed categorical assertion, domain {yes, no}, no default, presence-before-value, free supersession.
